purpose: The toolchain of the DEVELOPMENT machine the canonical documents describe. tools/check_doc_claims.py compares every `cargo 1.97.1` / `node 20.20.2` / `npm 10.8.2` claim in the canonical read set against THIS file, and compares this file against the real machine when it is running on one. Until 2026-08-30 it compared the documents directly against whatever machine it ran on -- and it runs in CI, where the machine is a GitHub runner with a different node. So a gate written to catch `cargo 1.96` on a 1.97.1 box could only ever be red in CI, and the four canonical files it named were CORRECT. The claim needs one source of record; this is it.
machine: Debian 13 (Linux 6.12.95+deb13-amd64), the Owner's box. Not a Windows box: five canonical documents said cargo needed PowerShell because Git Bash's `link` shadows MSVC's `link.exe`, which was true of the previous machine.
how_to_update: Run `cargo --version`, `node -v`, `npm -v` on the development box and paste what they print, in the same commit as the documents you are correcting. Do not edit a number here to make a document pass -- the direction is machine -> this file -> documents.
